note: What a server sends to say one unit hurt another. A client shows the figure and nothing more: the health it shows for the unit is what replication carries, and this message leaves it as it was.

fields.name: result
fields.note: How the damage landed, and so what a client shows over the unit hurt.

0.name: invulnerable
0.note: Shows that the unit could not be hurt.

3.name: critical
3.note: Shows the amount as a critical strike.

fields.name: unknown1
fields.note: One byte between result and kind. Zero in everything observed.

fields.name: kind
fields.note: What sort of damage it is.
